shortDescription: API interaction with Scale Computing HyperCore

options.name: data
options.description: A Dict containing a data to be sent to HyperCore REST endpoint. If I(action=patch), data we're updating the resource with. If I(action=get), data option is going to be ignored. If I(action=post) the resource will be created from the data. If I(action=delete), data option is going to be ignored. If I(action=post_list), data will be send as list instead of dict.

options.name: endpoint
options.description: The raw endpoint that we want to perform post, patch or delete operation on.

options.name: source
options.description: Source of the file to upload.
